label: v3-student-1-c1
brief:
SETTING:
Present-day autumn, over one school week in a quiet suburban town. The second-floor classroom has cream walls, east windows facing a paved courtyard, and desks in rows. Evan sits beside the windows; Maya and Leo sit at the neighboring desks, close enough to see his paper. Morning light falls across the desktops, while the corridor beyond the classroom door stays dim. The upstairs bedroom has pale blue walls, one window facing a quiet street, and a wooden desk beneath it. It sits above the family kitchen, away from the school; at night, the window reflects the desk lamp rather than the street. Evan has short black hair, a navy hoodie, and round glasses. Maya has a dark ponytail, a mustard cardigan, and silver stud earrings. Leo has curly brown hair, a gray sweatshirt, and a red wristband. Keep these clothes and details unchanged. The film uses naturalistic light, restrained contrast, and a softly muted grade: cool classroom mornings, warm lamplight at night, with no exaggerated change in color when Evan succeeds.

CLIP 1 OF 3 (15 seconds; what happens in clip 2 is not shown here):
The second-floor classroom has cream walls, east windows facing a paved courtyard, and desks in rows. Begin in a medium shot of Evan beside the windows. Evan has short black hair, a navy hoodie, and round glasses. He turns over his returned test. Cut close: “38/100” is clear; other marks are indistinct. Maya has a dark ponytail, a mustard cardigan, and silver stud earrings. Leo has curly brown hair, a gray sweatshirt, and a red wristband. Maya leans over and points at the score. Leo looks, smirks, and nudges Maya; she covers a mocking grin. Evan lowers his eyes and pulls the paper toward himself. End close on his hand covering the score.

tools.prompt: Create a 15-second silent naturalistic drama about Evan’s returned test in a present-day suburban school classroom, widescreen 16:9. Cool autumn morning light, realistic textures, restrained contrast and quiet social tension. Five coherent shots maintain the same students, clothing, paper and neighboring desks throughout. 0–3 seconds: medium shot of Evan, short black hair, navy hoodie and round glasses, turning over his returned test beside the east windows; cream walls and rows of desks frame the second-floor classroom, with a paved courtyard below; slowly push in. 3–6 seconds: close shot of the paper as Maya, already leaning beside Evan, points at the clearly legible score, exactly '38/100'; all other marks are indistinct; her dark ponytail, mustard cardigan and silver stud earrings remain visible at the upper edge, morning light crossing the desktop; slide gently sideways. 6–9 seconds: medium three-shot of Leo, curly brown hair, gray sweatshirt and red wristband, nudging Maya while smirking toward the test; Maya’s hand conceals a mocking grin, Evan’s eyes are downcast, and the corridor beyond the classroom door is dim; make a restrained lateral move. 9–12 seconds: tight shot of Evan’s hand pulling the paper toward himself across the sunlit wooden desktop; his palm rests over the score by the end, fully concealing it; ease closer. 12–15 seconds: final close-up of Evan’s motionless hand covering the score, the paper against his navy cuff on the desktop; finish the push and settle into a still hold for the final two seconds. Softly muted grade, measured pacing without a dramatic color shift. No subtitles, text overlays or additional scenes; clip 1 of 3 ends on the covered score.
